speak.prosody: Introduction Welcome! You’re about to step into the world of Rich Dad, Poor Dad by Robert T. Kiyosaki—a story that invites you to rethink everything you know about money, education, and success. Imagine growing up with two father figures, each offering completely different advice about life and finances. One encourages you to focus on school, get good grades, and find a stable job. The other urges you to seek financial independence, embrace entrepreneurship, and let your money work for you. These two approaches create a fascinating push and pull. On one side, there’s a belief in playing it safe, following the traditional path, and valuing job security above all else. On the other, there’s a call to question the status quo, take calculated risks, and build real wealth by learning how money actually works. What you’ll discover is that our attitudes about money are often handed down to us—we rarely stop to examine them, or to consider if they’re really serving us. Through personal stories, practical advice, and thought-provoking questions, this journey will challenge you to look beyond the old rules. You’ll be encouraged to move from simply earning a paycheck to building assets and investing in your future. Along the way, the importance of financial education, smart decision-making, and the courage to break out of the mold will come into sharp focus. So, let’s get started. Together, we’ll explore how a shift in mindset can open up new possibilities—and set you on the path to lifelong prosperity.
